preconditions.description: The number of necklace parts is between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a < 2**20 and 0 <= b < 2**20 for a, b in parts)
preconditions.description: Each pearl color is a non-negative integer less than 2^20.

postconditions.description: The maximum possible beauty of the necklace is between 1 and 20.
The number of pearl indices in the output is twice the number of necklace parts.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= 2 * n for p_i in p)
postconditions.description: Each pearl index is between 1 and 2n.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(p[i] - p[i+1]) == 1 or abs(p[i] - p[i+1]) == 2*n-1 for i in range(2*n))
postconditions.description: Necklace parts are connected in the cycle, with each part's pearls appearing consecutively.

postconditions.expression: all((p[i] % 2 != p[i+1] % 2) for i in range(2*n))
postconditions.description: Pearls from different parts alternate in the cycle.
